# Psychometric Digital Twin: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against the case study and `Exios66/psych755-jjb` `100110f` (25 August 2026) on 30 October 2026.

## Sample size

241 respondents were analysed, from 252 matched Prolific and Qualtrics records. The résumé page now uses 241 as the analysed N. The repository's test-function grep (114 `def test_` functions) was not promoted into the case-study stats, which are about the survey, not the suite.

:::
